subject: História
description_pt: Identificar os processos de formação das culturas e dos povos, relacionando-os com o espaço geográfico ocupado.

components.description_pt: Identificar os processos pelos quais diferentes culturas e povos se formaram historicamente
components.description_en: Identify the processes by which different cultures and peoples were formed historically
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how different cultures portray similar topics in myths and traditional literature

components.description_pt: Relacionar a formação de culturas e povos aos espaços geográficos que ocuparam
components.description_en: Relate the formation of cultures and peoples to the geographic spaces they occupied

components.description_pt: Descrever como o contexto geográfico influenciou o desenvolvimento de identidades culturais distintas
components.description_en: Describe how geographic context influenced the development of distinct cultural identities
components.cc_component_description: Identify natural resources that have influenced the development of human settlements or societies

cc_matches.description: Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.
Resource availability has guided the development of human society.
